name: Melfesh Monster
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Growth
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The Melfesh Monster takes physical damage

Effect The Melfesh Monster shifts plant matter to blunt the attack. It gains resistance 5 against the triggering physical damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Sporesight
defensiveAbilities.description: If a creature has inhaled any of the Melfesh Monster's spores, the Melfesh Monster can sense the creature at the listed range.

defensiveAbilities.name: Terrorspores
defensiveAbilities.description:
60 feet. A creature that enters the emanation must attempt a DC 21 Will Saving Throw save. Regardless of outcome, the creature is temporarily immune to terrorspores for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1 and inhales spores that remain in its body for 1 minute.

Failure As success, but Frightened 2 and the spores remain for 1 hour.

Critical Failure As success, but Frightened 3, the spores remain for 1 hour, and the creature's frightened condition can't be reduced below 1 as long as spores remain in its body.

offensiveAbilities.name: Envelop
offensiveAbilities.description: The Melfesh Monster attempts to Grapple a creature within reach. On a success, the creature is pulled into the Monster's body. The Melfesh Monster is Slowed 1 while it envelops a creature, and this otherwise has the effects of Swallow Whole (the Melfesh Monster's size or smaller, 1d10 Bludgeoning Damage]{1d10 bludgeoning and 1d12 poison}, Rupture 15).

offensiveAbilities.name: Fulminate
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The Melfesh Monster has created a spore cloud, and the cloud is within range of one of the Melfesh Monster's fire abilities

Effect The Melfesh Monster targets the cloud with one of its abilities with the fire trait. The spore cloud explodes, dealing 4d10 Fire Damage|options:area-damage]{4d10 fire damage and 4 persistent fire damage} in a 40ft Burst originating from a single square within the cloud (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Spore Cloud
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The Melfesh Monster conjures a cloud of spores within 60 feet in a 20ft Burst. The cloud lasts 1 minute. Creatures that enter or begin their turn within the cloud must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save or take 3d8 Poison Damage damage, be Sickened 2, and inhale spores that remain in their bodies for 1 minute (on a critical failure, Sickened 3 and an additional 4 Persistent,poison Damage damage).
